title: Schema enforcement alerting and automated evals for structured-output regressions
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a schema-enforcement layer that continuously evaluates structured outputs (JSON/JSON-LD) against declared schemas and raises alerting signals when regressions exceed configurable thresholds after model/config rollouts. The goal is to catch regressions where outputs no longer conform to required fields/types or where downstream validity checks fail, and tie those signals to model/config change metadata so SRE/ML teams can pinpoint the root cause quickly.
acceptance_criteria: A background job validates a sampling of production structured responses against the active JSON schema for each route and records per-schema pass/fail rates in metrics (Prometheus).
Team-configurable thresholds (failure rate %, consecutive window) trigger alerts routed to the appropriate Slack channel and create an incident ticket in the console.

Alert payload includes model id, model version, config snapshot (batching, quantization profile), recent rollout identifier, recent deploy time, and a compact sample of failed outputs with schema diffs (schema path and failing value).
Dashboard in Console shows historical schema conformity by route/model/config and can be filtered by rollout ID, region, and customer tier.

Automated follow-up eval: when an alert fires, run a deterministic eval harness that replays a curated prompt set (from evals repo) against the pinned model/config and produces a detailed regression report saved to the evals artifact store.
plan: Design metric topology and labels: route_id, model_id, model_version, config_hash, rollout_id, region, env.
Prototype lightweight validator library in runtime sidecar (C++/Rust shim) to compute schema conformance quickly for streaming outputs.
Implement sampling and aggregation pipeline (ingest -> validator -> metrics exporter).
Add alerting rules in Prometheus/alertmanager with templated Slack messages and incident creation hooks for Console.
Integrate automated eval runner that triggers on alert and uploads report + suggested rollback recommendations.
UX: add Console view for schema-conformity trends and alert drilldown.
notes: We must avoid high-cardinality labels on Prometheus. Use hashed config id and map to metadata in Console; do not include full customer ids in metrics.
Validator should be permissive for non-required fields by default but configurable per-route via a schema-strictness level (per-route policy).
Take care with PII: failed samples must be scrubbed before being included in alert payloads or stored in the evals artifact store. See compliance runbook.
updates: 2026-03-02: Spike complete for validator library. Implemented prototype using simdjson and generated a microbenchmark. Baseline latency added ~0.6ms per response for small payloads. — Maya

2026-03-08: MVP metrics schema reviewed. Decided to avoid model_version label explosion; use model_family + model_version_hash. Plan to map hash -> version in Console. — Maya

rollback_strategy: If a schema-conformance alert exceeds P1 threshold during a rollout, automatically pause the rollout and trigger a canary rollback to the previous model_version. Console incident card will list recommended rollback steps and the eval report comparing outputs.
qa_test_plan: Unit tests for validator against edge-case schemas (nested arrays, optional union types, numeric coercion).
Staging rollout that toggles schema-strictness levels and verifies alerts at expected thresholds.
End-to-end test that injects synthetic failing responses to ensure alert -> eval-run -> report flow works and that redaction rules are applied.
